claim: Figure 1a's heat map shows siRNA knockdown AND mRNA expression "in IGROV-1 cells"
locus_a: Figure 1 caption, main text (PMC12869450 fulltext): "Heat map of the RNA delivery based on their relative knockdown (Luc siRNA) or expression (Luc mRNA) in IGROV-1 cells"
locus_b: The siRNA half is explicitly a re-analysis of reference 11 (Zhou et al., PNAS 2016, PMID 26729861) -- "We analyzed the data from the prior siRNA screen and qualitatively classified...". The corpus holds that screen as KZ_2016 with Model_type = HeLa on all 1,512 rows.
what_we_emitted: Only the mRNA half, as Model_type = IGROV1. The siRNA half is NOT emitted.
why: Either the prior screen was run in IGROV-1 and the corpus's HeLa label is wrong, or the caption attributes this paper's cell line to borrowed data. We cannot tell from this paper, and emitting the siRNA half would commit to one answer. See DECISIONS.md D-2.

claim: The Venn diagram (Figure 1c) classifies each amine core as siRNA-only, mRNA-only or both
locus_a: Figure 1c: siRNA-only {3A3, 4A1, 4A4, 5A1, 6A2}; both {3A5, 4A3, 5A3, 5A4, 6A1, 6A3}; mRNA-only {3A2, 3A4, 5A2}; 3A1 absent from both circles
locus_b: Figure 1a read cell by cell under the caption's own binning rule: 3A1 has 5 cells in the top mRNA band (> log2) yet appears in NEITHER circle; 3A3 and 4A1 have 4 and 7 top-band mRNA cells yet sit in siRNA-only; 3A2 and 3A4 have 7 and 3 intermediate-band siRNA cells yet sit in mRNA-only
what_we_emitted: Nothing. The Venn is not used as a value or as a check.
why: The paper states a binning rule for the heat map and no rule at all for the Venn, and no threshold we tried reproduces the Venn from the heat map. It is an author judgement, so it cannot serve as the reproducible printed statistic it looks like. Recorded so a later reader does not try to use it as one.

claim: SC3 is a thiol tail of the 465-member library
locus_a: Figure 1b draws SC3 as an UNBRANCHED chain: the raster trace finds 0 skeleton branch nodes, 3 bond segments and bbox height 9 px (the branched SC1 and SC2 measure 1 and 3 branch nodes and 18-19 px). That is n-propanethiol, CCCS.
locus_b: corpus data_vitro.csv KZ_2016 IL_SMILES encodes NEOPENTYL (CC(C)(C)CS) on all 15 SC3 lipids -- and the SAME rows' IL_tail1_SMILES column says CCCS, so the corpus disagrees with itself. CLAUDE.md section 9 (2026-10-28) records an SC3 patch citing "source metadata pins neopentyl".
what_we_emitted: Propyl, CCCS, on all 15 SC3 lipids, with the disagreement queued.
why: Our evidence is a measurement of THIS paper's drawing; the corpus's is upstream metadata we cannot see. Both cannot be right, and 15 structures turn on it. DECISIONS.md D-4. NOT resolved here.

claim: 3A2 is one of the 15 amine cores
locus_a: Figure 1b draws 3A2 as 1-(2-aminoethyl)PIPERAZINE: a six-ring carrying "N" on one side and "NH" on the other, plus a pendant NH2 -- three nitrogens, which is also what "3 arms" requires
locus_b: corpus KZ_2016 IL_SMILES for every 3A2 lipid has TWO nitrogens (a piperidine ring), giving molecular formula C52H94N2O12S3 against our C51H93N3O12S3 for 3A2-SC6
what_we_emitted: The piperazine, on all 31 3A2 lipids, with the disagreement queued.
why: The formulae differ, so this is not a convention -- one of the two is a wrong structure. DECISIONS.md D-6.

claim: The size of the LNP formulations ranged from 100 to 200 nm
locus_a: Main text, Formulation Characterization: "Generally, the size of the LNP formulations ranged from 100 to 200 nm"
locus_b: SI Figure S3 text table: 5A5-SC8 = 248 nm and 5A5-SC10 = 203 nm; 40 of 42 inside the stated range
what_we_emitted: Nothing (diameter is not a corpus delivery endpoint).
why: The word "generally" may be doing the work, but the two outliers are in the same table the sentence describes and both belong to the worst-performing family. Recorded because a reader checking the claim will find it 40/42, not 42/42.

claim: Figures 2b and 3b report the same quantity, average liver radiance, from the same assay
locus_a: Both panels are labelled "Avg. Liver Radiance (p/sec/cm2/sr)", same dose (0.25 mg/kg), same strain, same 6 h timepoint
locus_b: Figure 2b's axis tops at 1e6 and its maximum bar is 7.37e5; Figure 3b's axis tops at 6e7 and its maximum bar is 4.09e7 -- a ~55x difference. The panels share NO lipid and NO benchmark control, and the IVIS colour bars differ by 100x (x10^5 vs x10^7).
what_we_emitted: Two Experiment_IDs, SL_2025 (Figure 2b) and SL_2025_2 (Figure 3b), z-scored separately, marked PROVISIONAL on every row.
why: Pooling would delete a between-cohort offset we cannot measure (error class 22, what F-016 cost on 5,040 rows); splitting asserts an offset exists. Nothing in the paper decides it. DECISIONS.md D-1.

claim: 3A4V-SC5 was formulated and imaged like the other 41 lipids
locus_a: Figure 2b draws NO bar at its x tick (zero coloured pixels above the baseline), and SI Figure S3 gives it a diameter, PDI, pKa and E.E. like every other formulation
locus_b: Figure 5a plots a 3A4V red triangle at pK_a 6.14 -- exactly this lipid's SI value -- sitting ON the x-axis rule, i.e. a value at or very near zero
what_we_emitted: Nothing. The row is not emitted.
why: A bar of zero height and a marker merged into the axis are both consistent with "very small" and with "not measurable". We will not invent a number for it. DECISIONS.md D-3.

locus_a: SI p1 Table of Contents: "1 Supporting Figures and Physical Characterization Data ... 2" and "2 NMR Data ... 7"
locus_b: SI p3 carries the heading "4. NMR Data" and the NMR peak lists begin there, on page 3, not page 7
why: Cosmetic, but it is the kind of drift that makes a page citation wrong. Recorded so a reviewer locating the NMR data is not sent to page 7.

locus_a: Task brief and several indexes: "...for siRNA and mRNA Lipid Nanoparticle Delivery"
locus_b: The article title page, the SI title page, PubMed (PMID 40644303) and Europe PMC all read "...for siRNA and mRNA Lipid Nanoparticle Design"
why: Trivial, and recorded because a title mismatch is how a duplicate entry gets created in lit_review.

claim: corpus-internal, found while checking ours against it: KZ_2016's SC3 rows
locus_a: corpus KZ_2016 3A4-SC3: IL_SMILES encodes a neopentyl tail and IL_tail1_SMILES says CCCS
locus_b: the same rows' Molecular.Weight is 983.41, which is the value carried by 3A4-SC2 and 3A4-SC5 -- both C5 tails -- while a C3 tail gives 899.25 and the neopentyl C5 gives 983.41

why: Reported, not repaired. Whichever way D-4 goes, the KZ_2016 SC3 rows currently carry three mutually inconsistent statements of the same tail across three columns.
